messages:
maria: Quick heads up 1: spotted a broken fragment on the runtime KB page. Link: https://kb.redwood.ai/serving/runtime#kvcache-deepdive 11 it loads but doesn't scroll.

devon: thanks. is that in prod or staging?

maria: prod. staging shows same. Looks like the heading was changed to 'KV cache deep-dive' which yields `#kv-cache-deep-dive`. callers still reference the old `#kvcache-deepdive`.

lee: I reshuffled that guide last sprint, might be on me. happy to take ownership and patch callers.

maria: want me to open a tiny PR to update the three pages referencing the old fragment? I can also add an owners line in the runtime frontmatter.

devon: yes please open a branch and PR. don't sed main directly. also add a one-liner in the PR body for changelog tracking.

docs-bot: link-checker (scheduled) reported 1 failing fragment: /serving/runtime.html#kvcache-deepdive -> created issue #4412.

lee: plan: maria opens PR with replacements + frontmatter owners: "@lee". devon will review lint. I'll follow up with a small docs-lint rule to warn on unresolved fragments.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1278 1 1 updated 3 links + added owners. CI preview running.

devon: reviewing now. tiny nit: could you include which files changed in the PR description? helps release notes.

maria: added files list. CI green. merging when docs-team gives final ack.

lee: after merge I'll trigger the scheduled link-checker and post results here. thanks all.

maria: resolved for now. ping if the bot finds anything else.
